newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-BELARUS GRATEFUL FOR LATE EQUALISER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELARUS GRATEFUL FOR LATE EQUALISER.

text.p: Vladimir Makovsky capped a fine individual performance with a goal 12 minutes from time to earn Belarus a 1-1 draw against Latvia in World Cup qualifying group four on Wednesday.
Latvian midfielder Mihails Zemlinskis had opened the scoring in the 16th minute to the dismay of more than 5,000 fans at Minsk stadium.

But Belarus, who lost 1-0 to Estonia last weekend, did enough to salvage a point which lifted them to third in the group behind Sweden and Scotland. Latvia remain bottom with a solitary point from three matches.
"I have a very limited choice of players here in Belarus. That's why I am not disappointed with a draw. It's fine that we have not lost this match," said Belarus's chief coach Sergei Borovsky.

Belarus: 1-Valery Shantalosov, 2-Sergei Gurenko, 3-Andrei Ostrovsky, 4-Sergei Shtanyuk, 5-Viktor Bezmen, 6-Rodislav Orlovsky, 7-Alexander Kulchiy, 8-Oleg Chernyavsky (Yuri Vergeichik 90th), 9-Yuri Maleyev, 10-Vladimir Makovsky, 11-Petr Kachuro (Alexander Vyazhevich 60th)

Latvia: 1-Olegs Karavajevs, 2-Igors Troitckis, 3-Vitalijs Astafjevs, 4-Mihails Zemlinskis, 5-Jurijs Sevljakovs (Arturs Zakresevskis 64th), 6-Igors Stepanovs, 7-Valerijs Ivanovs, 8-Imants Bleidelis, 9-Vitas Rinkus (Rolands Bulders 67th), 10-Armands Zeiberlins (Vladimirs Babicevs 46th), 11-Marjans Pahaks.
